# severity: error|warning|advisory · fix_mode: auto|suggest|manual · replacement uses $1.. for regex, {{nm}} = relative path to node_modules

message: mcp-use/server is the v1 import; v2 imports from "mcp-use".
Tool is not exported; views and useCallTool resolve tools through exported refs (export const x = server.tool(...)).
Server module has no default export; mcp-use dev/build/start load the default export.
Deprecated response helper imported from "mcp-use"; return a raw CallToolResult ({ content, structuredContent }).
Tool with view: has no outputSchema; a view-bound tool needs outputSchema and matching structuredContent.
Module-level Map used as per-user or session state; requests are stateless and concurrent, so use an external store.
Boolean mcp-use CLI flags take no value (--tunnel, not --tunnel=false).
MCPServer has no branding option; websiteUrl, icons, favicon and logging are top-level options.
ctx.elicit() does not exist in v2; return inputRequired({ inputRequests }) and read ctx.inputResponses.
ctx.log() and ctx.sample() do not exist in v2; use ctx.sendLog(level, data).
supportsApps() was removed; use ctx.client.supportsViews().
v1 widget API; use useToolContext<"tool">() from mcp-use/react (there is no aggregate provider).
Tool must set readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and openWorldHint as explicit booleans (ChatGPT review).
Invocation status text must be 64 characters or fewer.
Tool returns structuredContent but declares no outputSchema.
View has no domain; ChatGPT plugin submission requires _meta.ui.domain (unique per plugin).
pip is not supported by ChatGPT per OpenAI's extensions spec (inline and fullscreen only); unconfirmed.
@openai/apps-sdk-ui has no Card component; use a div with semantic tokens (rounded-2xl border border-default bg-surface p-4).
AppsSDKUIProvider requires linkComponent (use "a" for plain anchors).
toolOutput read without status: narrow on context.status === "ready" first (pending and error have no output).
useViewTheme() returns the string "light" | "dark", not { theme }.

replacement: attachments.map(({ key, block }) => [key, block] as const)
message: useModelContext().attachments is a readonly array of { key, block }, not a Record.
useModelContext().attachments is an array of { key, block }; find by key with attachments.find((a) => a.key === "k").
apps-sdk-ui CSS imported without @source; Tailwind 4 will not generate the components' utility classes.
Custom fonts break the ChatGPT look; inherit the system font stack (also add fonts to CSP only if you keep them).
Browser storage for core state: keep business data on the server and UI state in useViewState.
Nested scrolling in an inline card; cards should auto-fit their content.
More than two actions in an inline card (limit: one primary, one optional secondary).
Tabs or multi-view navigation inside a card; split into separate cards or tool actions.
window.openai used without feature detection (window.openai?.method) and the same view should work on other hosts.
Image without alt text (WCAG AA; ChatGPT guidelines).
Custom gradients break ChatGPT's minimal look; use system colors.
Iframe in a view: allowed only for your own registrable domain with a written justification.
server.settings fields are { schema, title, description? }; there is no type, label, default or secret, and read/update return the values.
ChatGPT deep links use ?path=<encoded-app-relative-url> (hostContext["openai/deepLink"]), not ?route=.
Credential collection (API keys, passwords, one-time codes) is restricted data for ChatGPT plugins.
Views import @openai/apps-sdk-ui components but no vite.config excludes it from optimizeDeps; mcp-use dev then fails to render them. Add vite.config.ts with optimizeDeps.exclude.
